ios-foundations|Writing.summary: W15B localized writing, sentence case, consistent terminology and specific action labels.

variants.name: W15B: Style and grammar
variants.swiftui: Use localized SwiftUI Text keys; keep sentences whole for translators.
variants.uikit: Load complete localized strings through NSLocalizedString before assigning labels.
variants.appkit: Use NSLocalizedString with translator comments for complete label strings.
variants.use: Store complete sentences in localized resources; use American English source copy and preserve placeholders.

variants.name: W15B: Capitalization
variants.swiftui: Text preserves resource capitalization; do not apply uppercased() to UI copy.
variants.uikit: Keep localized button titles as authored instead of uppercasing them.
variants.use: Use sentence case in resource values; preserve proper product names and acronyms.

variants.name: W15B: Terminology
variants.swiftui: Reuse one localized key for the same action or concept.
variants.uikit: Share localized keys instead of introducing screen-specific synonyms.
variants.appkit: Use the same localization catalog terms across menus and controls.
variants.use: Use the reviewed glossary consistently for the same concept across screens and resource keys.

variants.name: W15B: Action labels
variants.swiftui: Use Button with a localized action title; retain the native activation behavior.
variants.uikit: Use setTitle for the visible action and avoid a conflicting accessibilityLabel.
variants.appkit: Use an NSButton title naming the action; preserve keyboard activation.
variants.use: Name the action and result with a verb such as Save changes; visible and accessible labels agree.

variants.name: W15B: Text alternatives
variants.swiftui: Use Image accessibilityLabel for meaning and accessibilityHidden(true) for decoration.
variants.uikit: Assign an informative UIImageView accessibilityLabel; set decorative isAccessibilityElement to false.
variants.appkit: Set informative NSImageView accessibilityLabel; remove decorative images from accessibility with setAccessibilityElement(false).
variants.use: Describe the meaning of an informative image; decorative images have no separate accessibility stop.

anatomy: Localized resource keys and translator comments
Visible and accessible labels with matching meaning

ios-implementation|How to build.summary: W15B native implementation and web-package boundaries; browser adapters and web linters remain web tooling.

variants.name: W15B: Platforms standard
variants.swiftui: Import generated PlenixTokens and use SwiftUI layout, navigation and environment values.
variants.uikit: Use generated tokens with Auto Layout and native navigation and input controls.
variants.appkit: Use generated tokens with AppKit layout, menu commands and key-view navigation.
variants.use: Use the existing platform standard and generated tokens; retain native layout, navigation and input behavior.

variants.name: W15B: Mobile web
variants.swiftui: For hosted web content, test its responsive viewport in WKWebView; native screens use SwiftUI safe areas.
variants.uikit: Test hosted content in WKWebView separately from native UIKit layouts.
variants.appkit: Mobile web guidance applies to browser content, not native AppKit layout.
variants.use: This is browser implementation guidance, not a native adapter; validate narrow layouts and touch input in the actual browser.

variants.name: W15B: Desktop
variants.swiftui: Support macOS commands, keyboard shortcuts and resizable SwiftUI scenes.
variants.uikit: Use native keyboard and pointer interaction where supported; do not copy desktop dimensions into touch layouts.
variants.appkit: Use NSWindow resizing, menu commands and the native key-view loop.
variants.use: Keep desktop keyboard operation, focus restoration and resizable layouts distinct from narrow-screen behavior.

variants.name: W15B: Native implementation
variants.swiftui: Consume generated Swift tokens with native SwiftUI views.
variants.uikit: Consume generated Swift tokens with UIKit controls and accessibility APIs.
variants.appkit: Consume generated Swift tokens with AppKit controls and accessibility APIs.
variants.use: Generate tokens through the existing build; use platform controls and additive native guidance instead of browser wrappers.

variants.name: W15B: Browser support policy
variants.swiftui: WKWebView uses the system WebKit engine; verify required browser capabilities in hosted content.
variants.uikit: Evaluate capability checks inside WKWebView, not through UIKit version assumptions.
variants.appkit: Validate hosted WKWebView content separately; AppKit controls do not implement browser fallbacks.
variants.use: Browser queries and capability fallbacks apply to web builds only; browser engines inside native hosts need separate testing.

variants.name: W15B: Vue
variants.swiftui: Use native SwiftUI components for native screens; Vue belongs only inside separately hosted web content.
variants.uikit: Use UIKit for native screens; any Vue UI remains web content in WKWebView.
variants.appkit: Use AppKit for native screens; Vue remains browser content if hosted.
variants.use: The Vue package mounts the React web runtime; it does not create native controls or replace native token builds.

variants.name: W15B: Lint tooling
variants.swiftui: Run the Swift compiler and native accessibility review; the web ESLint plugin does not lint SwiftUI.
variants.uikit: Compile UIKit sources and run native accessibility checks separately from web lint.
variants.appkit: Compile AppKit sources and inspect native keyboard and accessibility behavior.
variants.use: ESLint and Stylelint check web JavaScript and CSS; native compiler and accessibility checks remain separate.

variants.appkit: Use macOS Accessibility Inspector, VoiceOver and full keyboard access, including modal focus return.
